scope: 210 eligible LT TRAIN Few images, all21 approved classes
candidate_sampling: Uniform without replacement from each eligible Many raw-ID pool; raw-ID-keyed local RNG; fixed before outcomes
pilot_selection: First8 of a local seed20261029 permutation of the complete210; validate pipeline only; never choose final recipients using pilot outcomes
features: Cache once per raw image; original eval transform; FP32 GPU, then exact cast to float64 for NumPy frozen geometry
primary_estimand: Average over recipient-specific matched same-minus-different label consistency and logit margins; every recipient equal weight
standardized_margin_definition: Mean recipient delta margin divided by sample SD of recipient delta margins; zero SD handled explicitly
consistency: Accuracy and margin differences same sign; >=2/3 matched fine classes and >=2/3 superclasses have that margin direction
uncertainty: 2000 fixed-seed bootstrap resamples of fine-class clusters; descriptive conditional intervals, not training-seed or causal inference
interval_rule: Both95% cluster-bootstrap intervals exclude0 in same direction for an association candidate
prespecified_sensitivity: Recompute on existing matches with relative distance gap<=.05 only; retain raw output, no new donors/features/bins/ratios
gate: Poor distance quality, insufficient/concentrated coverage or clean wrong for most -> INCONCLUSIVE and no training GO. Adequate design but weak signal ->NO-GO. Robust association ->geometric candidate only.
native_PI_ratio: SKIPPED: chosen Clean backbone has no PIF; author/local full parity unverified. No optional ratio search.
